decisive_question.question: Is the FY26 earnings collapse a transient trough driven by the butter wind-down plus an input/margin shock that reverses as the restructuring completes, or the start of a durable impairment of the core egg franchise's economics?

evidence_for.claim: Consensus already models a sharp rebound beyond the trough — FY27E EBITDA $48.3M vs FY26E $4.0M, and FY27 forward TEV/EBITDA of 9.98x implies the market prices recovery a year out.
evidence_for.source_ref: CIQ Estimates→Trends (FY26/FY27 consensus EBITDA, latest snapshot)

evidence_for.claim: The butter exit is explicitly a refocus onto core egg categories, expected substantially complete by end of fiscal 2026, framing the hit as bounded and self-imposed rather than demand-driven.
Revenue guidance was cross-source VERIFIED at 775.0–800.0 and the company has met its revenue floor 7/7 times, so top-line delivery discipline is intact.
evidence_for.source_ref: CIQ Estimates→Guidance (latest guide + sign-aware delivery track-record)

evidence_against.claim: The most recent EBITDA guide was MISSED (FY 2025), and the forward adjusted-EBITDA outlook collapsed to 0.0–10.0, signalling the profit shortfall may be deeper than a bounded restructuring charge.
evidence_against.source_ref: CIQ Estimates→Guidance (latest guide + sign-aware delivery track-record)

evidence_against.claim: Q1-26 gross margin fell to 28.3% and adjusted EBITDA to $5.0M, showing current-period economics — not just projections — have already deteriorated sharply.
The founder and Executive Chairperson resigned concurrent with the first gap-down, removing continuity at the top just as the core strategy is being reset.
evidence_against.source_ref: EDGAR 8-K item codes at the gap-down dates (not blanket-labelled earnings)

key_unknowns: Cash runway is not derived despite FCF -$53.9M and negative latest-Q OCF — the actual months of self-funding capacity at current burn is undisclosed (a bearish opacity risk).

No forward/adjusted EV/EBITDA basis and no adjusted-EPS figure were in the revised 99.1 guidance, so cheap-overshoot vs cheap-terminal on a forward basis cannot be distinguished (trailing-only multiple, unresolved — neither bull nor bear).
Segment-level EBITDA is unavailable (Segments sheet has no EBITDA section), so the profitability drag from butter vs the core egg business cannot be isolated.
Covenant terms on the JPMorgan revolver are UNKNOWN (extraction failed) — covenant-basis leverage headroom is undisclosed (bearish opacity).
No revised-outlook 99.1 exhibit was parsed, so the precise bridge from prior to new guidance is not source-anchored beyond the summary figures.
The market 180d benchmark and any exposed cohort are unavailable, so idiosyncratic-vs-shared can only be read via the name-vs-IWM relative (-74%).
The as-of export date is unverified (a floor ≥ 2026-05-28); the true export is likely weeks newer, so consensus figures may be staler than the underlying data.

caveats: EV/EBITDA stale-price caveat — CIQ's Financials→Multiples current TEV/LTM 1.5x is priced at its last Close 2026-03-31, 97d before the 2026-07-06 reference; for a since-re-rated name this 'current' multiple AND the own-history range/percentile built on it are stale. The Comparable-Analysis sheet reads 1.2x on a current price — prefer that figure and re-pull the Financials multiple.

business_description.value: Vital Farms, Inc., a food company, packages, markets, and distributes shell eggs, butter, and other products in the United States. The company produces products sourced from animals raised on family farms, including shell eggs, stick butter, hard-boiled eggs, and liquid whole eggs under the Vital Farms brand and other trade names. It offers its products through third parties and direct to retailers, and commercial and non-commercial foodservice operators. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas.
